1,156 horsepower. 0-100 kmph in 2.5 seconds. Luxury, ground clearance, and supercar-slaying performance. Has Porsche just built the only car you will ever need?
We took the massive 2026 Porsche Cayenne Turbo E-Hybrid from the smooth highways of Pune to the broken, forgotten roads of Lavasa to answer one massive question: does a 2.6-ton hybrid SUV make every other car obsolete?
